name: The Shops at Tanforan
summary: The Shops at Tanforan is an eclectic regional mall in San Bruno featuring a diverse range of retail stores, a food court with multiple dining options, and entertainment amenities including Century Theatres and a kids' play area. This one-stop destination serves the Bay Area community with convenient shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences seven days a week.
demographics: The Shops at Tanforan attracts a diverse demographic mix from the San Bruno and greater San Mateo County area, serving middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The trade area draws heavily from young professionals and families aged 25-54 who work in nearby tech hubs and San Francisco International Airport-related industries. The center serves a multicultural customer base reflective of the Bay Area's diversity, with significant Asian-American and Hispanic populations who value convenient one-stop shopping for retail, dining, and entertainment. Shoppers typically seek a balance of value and quality, frequenting both national chains and specialty retailers for everyday needs and lifestyle purchases.
description: The Shops at Tanforan is a premier shopping destination located in San Bruno, California, offering an eclectic mix of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences under one roof. This regional mall features an extensive selection of stores spanning men's and women's apparel, accessories, beauty products, and home furnishings, providing shoppers with diverse options for every lifestyle need. Beyond shopping, the center enhances the visitor experience with a vibrant food court and specialty dining options that cater to varied tastes, making it an ideal spot for family outings and social gatherings. Entertainment is a cornerstone of the Tanforan experience, with Century Theatres providing the latest movie releases and a dedicated kids' play area ensuring fun for younger visitors. Conveniently located at 1150 El Camino Real with ample parking and accessible hours seven days a week, The Shops at Tanforan has established itself as a go-to community hub where Bay Area residents can shop, dine, and create lasting memories all in one location.
